verdict.rationale: All four options satisfy the stated arrival deadline and have Monday departures plausibly described as around lunch. A and D offer the convenience of nonstops but cost more; B is the cheapest but adds a connection; C is a middle-priced connection with an earlier arrival than B. Because EWR and LGA are both stated to be workable, the remaining tradeoffs are price, nonstop convenience, and small timing differences, none of which the query ranks.
